sn17.10:3.4: MS reads _appamāṇavihārino_ (“living unlimited”, see []()), with variant _appamādavihārino_, which is the main reading in the parallels to this line ([iti81:9.4](), [dhp57:2](), [thag17.2:31.4]()). [sn35.97]() discusses one who lives diligently, their sense restraint providing a foundation for deep meditation. This context fits well here, as the meditator is unaffected by honors.
